empresa.title: Setup manual — Company
empresa.intro: Quick guide to configure your corporate appMila account and start delegating tasks clearly.

items: Go to Structure → Manage holding.
Fill in legal name, tax ID, email, phone, timezone and language.
Upload the company logo (appears in the org chart and reports).
Under Structure, create the organizations (companies/units of the group).
Assign one or more administrators per organization.
Within each organization, create the areas (e.g.: Sales, IT, Finance).
Assign area administrators when needed.
Create the teams inside each area.
Register people (name, email, aliases and whether they can delegate).
Set the members of each team.
Go to Tasks → New.
Dictate by voice (hold the microphone) or type.
Set assignee, due date and priority.
Under Structure → Manage holding, open a ticket anytime.
The CONNBX team receives your ticket directly.

familia.title: Setup manual — Family
familia.intro: Quick guide to organize your family's and household staff's tasks in appMila.

items: Go to Structure → Manage holding.
Set the account's name, timezone and language.
Register spouse, children and parents.
Provide the email of anyone who will have their own app access.
Register staff: housekeeper, cook, cleaner, gardener, driver and others.
Set who can receive and who can delegate tasks.
Go to Tasks → New.
Speak holding the microphone or type.
Set assignee and due date (e.g.: 'Take the car for service tomorrow').
Under Structure → Manage holding, open a ticket whenever you need.

items.a: appMila is a task management platform that turns what gets said — in meetings, chats and daily life — into tasks with an owner and a deadline. It works for company teams and for families, in one account.
Hold the microphone, speak for up to 10 seconds and release. Your speech is transcribed into a task with a title, owner and deadline for you to review before creating it.

items.q: Is it for businesses and families?
items.a: Yes. appMila organizes both your work tasks (with your team) and your family routine — all in one account, with separate views.

items.q: Which devices does appMila work on?
items.a: On the web app (browser), the mobile app (Android, with iOS on the way) and a desktop agent. Your tasks stay in sync across them.

items.q: Does appMila have a free plan?
items.a: Yes. There's a free plan for families to start, plus paid plans for larger families and for companies.
